scope: Moor dossier rewritten from Vol.I–III, Editor Choice; no new invented history.

sources.title: Vol.I - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Marrakesh feast: Ziyad family granaries, communal kitchens, support of Castilian succession, Gibraltar merchant network.

sources.title: Vol.II - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Ziyad receives news of Edward’s disappearance and seeks evidence before accepting death.

sources.title: Vol.III - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Hashashin track Liv’s prisoner convoy, conceal routes and stores; Sultan present near Taourirt.
Gibraltar: Idris ibn Abd al-Rahman commands 20 Moor ships under Edward’s overall coordination; coastal pilots and fishing communities.
Palermo mandate: Morocco no longer Castilian colony; Ziyad also delegated Castilian negotiating authority; Idris attends as heir without signing authority.
Peace terms: relief of Fes and Roman withdrawal from Algeria.
Final ceremony: Ziyad Caliph of the West over voluntarily pledging communities, Idris temporal Sultan of Morocco.

limits: No claim of compulsory universal spiritual authority.
No new Caliph title assigned to Ziyad in 1715.
Existing borders, images, other dossiers and chapters preserved.
